resources.string: XAI-FLOWS is an innovative platform designed to revolutionize flood monitoring and prediction. By combining cutting-edge AI technology with explainability, XAI-FLOWS provides accurate and transparent flood warnings, predicting potential flooding events before they occur.
"\"Our platform not only predicts floods, but also helps you prepare by providing real-time alerts based on AI-driven data analysis\""
At XAI-FLOWS, we aim to create safer communities using AI and Explainable AI to predict and manage flood risks, helping people make informed decisions and protect lives and property.
We analyze drainage systems to predict and prevent blockages, reducing flood risks and ensuring smoother water flow during heavy rains.
We focus on low-lying areas, providing timely flood risk assessments to protect vulnerable communities.
We analyze annual rainfall patterns to predict flood risks and improve preparedness in prone regions.
Predict floods using advanced AI that analyzes drainage, rainfall, and terrain for accurate risk forecasts.
Stay updated with live monitoring of flood-prone areas and immediate risk detection.
Provides clear, transparent insights into how flood predictions are made.
Instant alerts to prepare and act before floods impact your area.
Simple, intuitive design for quick access to predictions and insights.
Visual maps and graphs for better understanding of flood risks and patterns.
The confusion matrix shows how our model’s predictions compare to actual outcomes, highlighting strengths and areas for improvement.
Comprehensive metrics highlight the model’s balanced precision, recall, and overall effectiveness.
The precision-recall curve shows performance across thresholds, helping balance false positives and negatives.
The ROC curve shows strong discriminative ability (AUC 0.90), far above random chance.
SHAP analysis highlights key environmental factors driving flood predictions, aiding model improvement and management.
